notes: Confirmed. The body queries selector 0x13, returns true immediately when the low byte is 4, otherwise performs a second selector-0x13 query and returns true only when that low byte is 3. Its caller tests the result as a Boolean gate. The two accepted values and selector match the label.

The body queries selector 0x61 and returns whether the 32-bit result is less than 0x6a4 under the signed GE condition. The caller consumes the result as a predicate. The proposal's threshold wording is right, but adding signed avoids implying an unsigned comparison.

The target calls a preparation helper, queries selector 0x13, then conditionally calls f_7000ab44b4 when the low byte is nonzero. That helper writes a sequence of computed bytes into the global table at 0x7003ac2fb0. The caller uses the target's constant-true result as a gate. This supports conditional table initialization, but the original 'context updates' phrasing is broader than the observed work.

Confirmed. The wrapper saves incoming x2, calls the accepted format_contextual_status_display_text helper with the original argument state, then returns the saved x2 in x0. Its caller uses the returned value as a separate result after the formatting call. This matches the descriptive wrapper name.

Confirmed. Each selector result is reduced by 0x23 and checked against inclusive upper offset 0x59; unsigned carry/range checks reject underflow and values above 0x7c. The function returns true only when both selectors 1 and 2 are within 0x23..0x7c. Its caller consumes the result as a predicate.
